# NordKiln
> Rent outdoor and winter gear in Northern Norway. Peer-to-peer rental of skis, snowshoes, snowboards, winter clothes, hiking/camping gear and wet/dry suits from locals in Troms (Tromsø, Balsfjord, Lyngen), expanding to Senja and Lofoten. Free pickup nearby, meeting points, or delivery where the owner offers it.

- Owners list for free. Renters see the full total (rent, service fee, any delivery) before they book.
- Instant booking: free dates are confirmed immediately and the renter gets the pickup place, times and the owner's phone right away. Payment by Vipps or cash at pickup. Some listings use request-based booking (owner answers within 24 h).
- NordKiln is a marketplace; the rental agreement is between owner and renter. Rental rules (deposit, return deadline, late return, damage, cancellation): https://nordkiln.dev/rules/
- Pickup at the owner is free; owners may add free meeting points and optional delivery priced per km (one way).
- Languages: English (https://nordkiln.dev/), Norwegian (https://nordkiln.dev/no/), German (https://nordkiln.dev/de/), Simplified Chinese (https://nordkiln.dev/zh/).
- Size search: shoe size (EU, with UK/US/CN hints), clothing size, body height. Listings carry shoe_eu, clothing_size, ski_length_cm, fits_height_cm.
- Contact: scan.nordkiln@mail.grokbot.com

## Current listings
- Völkl touring ski set with skins and boots: 450 NOK/day + renter fee, Seljelvnes, Balsfjord, pickup
- Cross-country skis: 250 NOK/day + renter fee, Seljelvnes, Balsfjord, pickup
- Snowshoes: 150 NOK/day + renter fee, Seljelvnes, Balsfjord, pickup
Live data: https://nordkiln.dev/listings.json
